pg_data_lead: Each Nurelo product works with its own master data and product-specific modules by default. That keeps every area clear on its own.
pg_data_r1_dd: Own master data and own, product-specific modules for each product.
pg_data_r2_dd: One shared database for several products, if you want that.
pg_data_r3_dd: You activate further modules as needed, without reinstalling.
st_pg_title: Nurelo Residential: care software for residential care facilities
st_pg_desc: Nurelo Residential manages residents, care planning according to the structure model, staff rota, billing and medication in residential care facilities, with its own master data and its own modules. Hosted in Germany.
st_pg_f1_p: All information about residents in one place, from admission to the record, including recording and evaluation of care levels.
st_pg_f2_h: Care planning with the structure model
st_pg_f2_p: SIS, measure plan, report sheet and evaluation in the same system, with care documentation and reports for quality inspections.
st_pg_f3_p: Shift planning, leave and absences for your team, fully configurable.
st_pg_f4_p: A complete overview of medication with an administration log.
st_pg_f5_p: Record and submit the half-yearly indicator data collection.
st_pg_f7_p: Manage your eKV in the same system.
st_pg_f8_p: Assign costs to the areas of your facility and keep an overview of the wages of your staff.
am_pg_title: Nurelo Home care: care software for home care services
am_pg_desc: Nurelo Home care plans routes, documents visits on the go and bills services under SGB XI and V according to § 302, with its own master data and its own modules. Hosted in Germany.
am_pg_f1_p: Route planning and staff rota with vehicle and staff assignment.
am_pg_f2_p: Record services under SGB XI and V in one workflow.
am_pg_f3_p: Manage vehicles and assign them to routes.
am_pg_f4_p: All information about your clients in one place.
am_pg_f5_p: A complete overview of medication with an administration log.
am_pg_f6_p: Document visits on the go, right on site, also offline and with a digital signature.
am_pg_f7_p: Keep the personnel files of your team digitally.
am_pg_f8_p: Billing under § 302, submitted directly to the payers.
hn_pg_title: Nurelo Emergency call: software for home emergency call providers
hn_pg_desc: Nurelo Emergency call manages participants, devices and alarm forwarding to the emergency call centre, analyses false and test alarms and bills monthly fees, with its own master data and its own modules. Hosted in Germany.
hn_pg_f1_p: All information about your participants in one place.
hn_pg_f2_p: Manage devices and assign them to participants.
hn_pg_f3_p: Forward alarms to the emergency call centre.
hn_pg_f4_p: Record and analyse false and test alarms.
hn_pg_f5_p: Manage wireless call buttons as emergency call devices.
hn_pg_f7_p: Manage the device contracts of your participants.
